name: Yamanaka Tomomi
source:
She is a first-year student at Rinin Academy.
Tomomi is known as one of the most beautiful girls in the school.
She is an all-around athlete and was chosen as an athlete for the women's gymnastics team, and her outstanding appearance has even led her to be featured in an idol magazine despite her being an athlete.
She has recently started dating a student named Tagami.
He is also good-looking and belongs to the baseball team, and is the kind of person who gets cheered at the regional qualifying rounds.
So, with the help of her older brother Satoshi, who is also a member of the baseball team, Tomomi chooses an out-of-the-way place in the school and has a series of small dates with him.

[Translated from the official site of the game, [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080701055257/http://lilith-soft.com/anime/product04.html]archived[/url]]
